versions.content: Support of secure data coding Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall support secure coding of authenticated data. A manufacturer signed certificate containing a public key followed by one or more write data requests is ensures the integrity of the data. Only data that matches the signature inside the certificate is accepted. Rationale: Secure coding data is already used in almost all ECUs and a standardized mechanism to secure and authenticate data writing shall be provided by AUTOSAR. Use Case: Storing of authenticated variant coding or other parameters via diagnostics. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: Concept 646 “Security Extensions Harmonized” – ISO 14229-1 – Authentication Service 0x29
